name: entity-type-guard-regression
description: Export-derived Wikipedia/Wikidata collisions plus spec-class coverage. Every case runs through classifyEntityTypeFromP31 — not company-name allow/block lists. Live P31 is recorded honestly; specClassCoverage cases use the reject-class QID named in the guard spec when Wikidata uses a sibling/empty P31.
